queries.query:
SELECT
    c.customer_tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_key) AS customer_count,
    SUM(f.extended_price) AS total_revenue,
    AVG(f.extended_price) AS avg_order_value
FROM fact_order_line f
JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
WHERE f.order_date_key >= '2023-01-01' AND f.order_date_key < '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY c.customer_tier
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT
    p.brand,
    p.container,
    SUM(f.quantity) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(f.revenue) AS total_revenue,
    AVG(f.discount) AS avg_discount
FROM fact_order_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.ship_date_key BETWEEN '2023-06-01' AND '2023-12-31'
  AND f.is_returned = FALSE
GROUP BY p.brand, p.container
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    dd.year,
    dd.month,
    SUM(f.extended_price * (1 - f.discount)) AS net_revenue,
    SUM(f.profit) AS total_profit,
    SUM(f.profit) / NULLIF(SUM(f.extended_price * (1 - f.discount)), 0) AS profit_margin
FROM fact_order_line f
JOIN dim_date dd ON f.ship_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.year >= 2022
GROUP BY dd.year, dd.month
ORDER BY dd.year, dd.month;

SELECT
    s.supplier_name,
    s.region_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.product_key) AS products_supplied,
    SUM(f.quantity) AS total_qty_shipped,
    SUM(f.revenue) AS total_revenue,
    AVG(f.days_to_ship) AS avg_days_to_ship
FROM fact_order_line f
JOIN dim_supplier s ON f.supplier_key = s.supplier_key
WHERE f.ship_date_key >= '2023-01-01'
  AND f.line_status = 'F'
GROUP BY s.supplier_name, s.region_name
HAVING SUM(f.revenue) > 100000
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT
    c.customer_name,
    c.region_name,
    SUM(f.extended_price) AS total_spent,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_key) AS order_count,
    MAX(f.order_date_key) AS last_order_date
FROM fact_order_line f
JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
WHERE f.order_date_key >= (SELECT MAX(order_date_key) FROM fact_order_line) - INTERVAL '1 year'
GROUP BY c.customer_name, c.region_name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    f.ship_mode,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.is_late_shipment THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_shipments,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.is_late_shipment THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS late_pct,
    AVG(f.days_to_ship) AS avg_days_to_ship
FROM fact_order_line f
WHERE f.ship_date_key >= '2023-01-01'
GROUP BY f.ship_mode
ORDER BY late_pct DESC;

SELECT
    p.product_type,
    SUM(f.quantity) AS total_qty,
    SUM(f.revenue) AS total_revenue,
    SUM(f.profit) AS total_profit,
    SUM(f.profit) / NULLIF(SUM(f.revenue), 0) AS profit_margin
FROM fact_order_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date dd ON f.order_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.year = 2023
GROUP BY p.product_type
ORDER BY total_profit DESC;

WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        dd.year,
        dd.month,
        c.region_name,
        SUM(f.revenue) AS monthly_revenue
    FROM fact_order_line f
    JOIN dim_date dd ON f.order_date_key = dd.date_key
    JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
    GROUP BY dd.year, dd.month, c.region_name
)
SELECT
    year,
    month,
    region_name,
    monthly_revenue,
    LAG(monthly_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY year, month) AS prev_month_revenue,
    CASE WHEN LAG(monthly_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY year, month) IS NOT NULL
         THEN ROUND(100.0 * (monthly_revenue - LAG(monthly_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY year, month))
              / LAG(monthly_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY year, month), 2)
         ELSE NULL END AS pct_change
FROM monthly_sales
ORDER BY region_name, year, month;

SELECT
    c.customer_key,
    c.customer_name,
    c.customer_tier,
    SUM(f.extended_price) AS lifetime_value,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_key) AS total_orders,
    MIN(f.order_date_key) AS first_order_date,
    MAX(f.order_date_key) AS last_order_date
FROM fact_order_line f
JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
WHERE f.is_returned = FALSE
GROUP BY c.customer_key, c.customer_name, c.customer_tier
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_key) >= 5
ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC;

SELECT
    p.brand,
    p.product_type,
    SUM(f.quantity) AS total_qty_sold,
    SUM(f.revenue) AS total_revenue,
    SUM(f.discount_amount) AS total_discounts,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(f.discount_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(f.extended_price), 0), 2) AS discount_pct
FROM fact_order_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.order_date_key >= '2023-01-01'
GROUP BY p.brand, p.product_type
HAVING SUM(f.quantity) > 1000
ORDER BY discount_pct DESC;

SELECT
    f.order_key,
    c.customer_name,
    f.order_date_key,
    SUM(f.extended_price) AS order_total,
    COUNT(*) AS line_items,
    MAX(f.ship_date_key) AS last_ship_date
FROM fact_order_line f
JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
WHERE f.order_date_key >= '2023-11-01'
GROUP BY f.order_key, c.customer_name, f.order_date_key
HAVING SUM(f.extended_price) > (
    SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_total)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(extended_price) AS order_total
        FROM fact_order_line
        WHERE order_date_key >= '2023-11-01'
        GROUP BY order_key
    ) t
)
ORDER BY order_total DESC;

SELECT
    dd.quarter,
    c.market_segment,
    SUM(f.revenue) AS segment_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_key) AS active_customers
FROM fact_order_line f
JOIN dim_date dd ON f.order_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
WHERE dd.year = 2023
GROUP BY dd.quarter, c.market_segment
ORDER BY dd.quarter, segment_revenue DESC;

SELECT
    s.supplier_name,
    p.brand,
    COUNT(*) AS supply_lines,
    SUM(f.quantity) AS total_qty,
    AVG(f.days_to_ship) AS avg_lead_time,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.is_late_shipment THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_count
FROM fact_order_line f
JOIN dim_supplier s ON f.supplier_key = s.supplier_key
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.ship_date_key >= '2023-01-01'
GROUP BY s.supplier_name, p.brand
HAVING COUNT(*) > 50
ORDER BY late_count DESC, avg_lead_time DESC;

WITH customer_yearly AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_key,
        c.customer_name,
        dd.year,
        SUM(f.revenue) AS yearly_revenue
    FROM fact_order_line f
    JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
    JOIN dim_date dd ON f.order_date_key = dd.date_key
    WHERE f.is_returned = FALSE
    GROUP BY c.customer_key, c.customer_name, dd.year
)
SELECT
    year,
    COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yearly_revenue > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_customers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN prev_year_revenue > 0 AND yearly_revenue = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS churned_customers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN prev_year_revenue = 0 AND yearly_revenue > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_customers
FROM (
    SELECT
        cy.*,
        LAG(yearly_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_key ORDER BY year) AS prev_year_revenue
    FROM customer_yearly cy
) t
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

SELECT
    p.product_name,
    p.brand,
    p.size,
    p.container,
    SUM(f.quantity) AS total_qty_ordered,
    SUM(f.extended_price) AS total_revenue,
    AVG(f.discount) AS avg_discount
FROM fact_order_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.order_date_key >= (SELECT MAX(order_date_key) FROM fact_order_line) - INTERVAL '6 months'
  AND f.return_flag = 'R'
GROUP BY p.product_name, p.brand, p.size, p.container
ORDER BY total_qty_ordered DESC
LIMIT 30;

SELECT
    c.nation_name,
    s.nation_name AS supplier_nation,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_key) AS order_count,
    SUM(f.quantity) AS total_qty,
    SUM(f.revenue) AS total_revenue,
    AVG(f.days_to_receipt) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM fact_order_line f
JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
JOIN dim_supplier s ON f.supplier_key = s.supplier_key
JOIN dim_date dd ON f.order_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.year = 2023
GROUP BY c.nation_name, s.nation_name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT
    p.product_key,
    p.product_name,
    p.retail_price,
    p.avg_supply_cost,
    p.total_avail_qty,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.quantity), 0) AS qty_sold_last_year,
    p.total_avail_qty - COALESCE(SUM(f.quantity), 0) AS estimated_remaining
FROM dim_product p
LEFT JOIN fact_order_line f
    ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    AND f.order_date_key >= (SELECT MAX(order_date_key) FROM fact_order_line) - INTERVAL '1 year'
    AND f.is_returned = FALSE
GROUP BY p.product_key, p.product_name, p.retail_price, p.avg_supply_cost, p.total_avail_qty
HAVING p.total_avail_qty - COALESCE(SUM(f.quantity), 0) < 100
ORDER BY estimated_remaining ASC;

SELECT
    dd.year,
    dd.month,
    SUM(f.extended_price * f.tax) AS total_tax_collected,
    SUM(f.tax_amount) AS total_tax_amount,
    AVG(f.tax) AS avg_tax_rate
FROM fact_order_line f
JOIN dim_date dd ON f.order_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.year >= 2022
GROUP BY dd.year, dd.month
ORDER BY dd.year, dd.month;

WITH order_stats AS (
    SELECT
        f.order_key,
        COUNT(*) AS line_count,
        SUM(f.quantity) AS total_qty,
        SUM(f.extended_price) AS order_value,
        MIN(f.ship_date_key) AS first_ship,
        MAX(f.receipt_date_key) AS last_receipt
    FROM fact_order_line f
    WHERE f.order_date_key >= '2023-01-01'
    GROUP BY f.order_key
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN line_count = 1 THEN 'Single Item'
        WHEN line_count <= 5 THEN 'Small (2-5)'
        WHEN line_count <= 20 THEN 'Medium (6-20)'
        ELSE 'Large (20+)'
    END AS order_size_category,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count,
    AVG(order_value) AS avg_order_value,
    AVG(total_qty) AS avg_total_qty,
    AVG(last_receipt - first_ship) AS avg_fulfillment_days
FROM order_stats
GROUP BY order_size_category
ORDER BY
    CASE order_size_category
        WHEN 'Single Item' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Small (2-5)' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Medium (6-20)' THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END;

SELECT
    c.customer_tier,
    dd.quarter,
    SUM(f.revenue) AS tier_quarter_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_key) AS customers,
    SUM(f.revenue) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_key), 0) AS revenue_per_customer
FROM fact_order_line f
JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
JOIN dim_date dd ON f.order_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.year = 2023
  AND f.is_returned = FALSE
GROUP BY c.customer_tier, dd.quarter
ORDER BY c.customer_tier, dd.quarter;
